title: Fae Bargain
description: A luminous sprite materializes from a swirl of golden motes, its form flickering between child and ancient thing. It speaks in riddles: 'Mortal! The forest remembers your tread. What will you offer for its secrets?' Its smile is too wide, its eyes too knowing.

choices.label: Offer gold tribute
choices.description: Pay 15 gold for the fae's favor.

outcomes.text: The sprite's eyes widen with delight. 'Generous! The forest thanks you.' Herbs and mushrooms materialize at your feet.
The sprite giggles and waves its hand. Golden light suffuses your party. 'A blessing for your kindness!'
The sprite pockets your gold and vanishes with a cackle. 'Fae bargains are final, mortal!' A few herbs drift down as consolation.

choices.label: Play its guessing game
choices.description: Risk your wits against fae cunning.

outcomes.text: You answer three riddles correctly. The sprite claps with childlike glee and showers you in gold dust that becomes real coins!
The sprite outsmarts you on the final riddle. 'Close! But not close enough.' It plucks gold from your pouch with invisible fingers.
The game ends in a draw. The sprite shrugs and fades away, leaving behind a single mushroom. 'For your effort, mortal.'

choices.label: Bow and withdraw
choices.description: Show respect but make no deals.

outcomes.text: The sprite tilts its head, surprised by courtesy. 'Wise for a mortal.' It fades without incident.
The sprite nods approvingly. 'Manners! How refreshing.' A small herb bundle appears in your hands as a parting gift.
